say:8:1021102006:1.source_cn: 没关系，我的朋友！不必客气！

say:10:1021102008:1.text: Intruders! He just called us intruders!
say:10:1021102008:1.source_cn: 入侵者，他在说我们是入侵者！

say:2:1021102103:0.text: You're fluent in gruglin! You do the translations next time!
say:2:1021102103:0.source_cn: 梅丽莎，你竟然这么精通咕咕语！下次的翻译工作能不能都交给你？

say:3:1021102104:0.text: ... There won't be a next time!

say:0:1021102201:0.text: It's the tablet! Just like the notes said!
say:0:1021102201:0.source_cn: 石碑，那就是传闻中的石碑！和探险记事里残缺的描述一样！

say:2:1021102301:0.text: All we need to do next is decipher everything! Melissa, this is a historical moment!
say:2:1021102301:0.source_cn: 接下来就只差解读工作了，梅丽莎，这简直是历史性的一刻！

say:3:1021102302:0.text: Dura above! All our travels have finally paid off! I actually don't have to reference or give credit to anyone else this time for a discovery...
say:3:1021102302:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，长久以来的跋涉终于有所收获，我不用在研究报告...

say:4:1021102303:0.text: Magister, I can't thank you enough for the help!
say:4:1021102303:0.male: Magister, I can't thank you enough for the help!
say:4:1021102303:0.female: Magister, I can't thank you enough for the help!

say:5:1021102304:0.text: ... Say, Melissa. Do you remember if a button is mentioned anywhere in our notes?
say:5:1021102304:0.source_cn: ……我说，梅丽莎，探险记事里有提过这里有个按钮吗？

narration:11:1020226:0.text: Gali accidentally activates the defense mechanism, awakening the guardian of the ruins.
narration:11:1020226:0.source_cn: 伽利触发了防御按钮，唤醒了遗迹守护者。

say:1:1021102402:0.text: It's a golem! I read about them in "28 Theories On Why The Gods Fell"... How could this thing be here?!
say:1:1021102402:0.source_cn: 是魔偶……我在《神的陨落与二十八相的猜测》中读到过！竟...

say:2:1021102501:1.source_cn: 真是太惊心动魄了……魔法师<male>先生</male...

say:3:1021102502:1.text: I can't even imagine the outcome of our research trip without you...
say:3:1021102502:1.source_cn: 如果没有你在，真是难以想象我们的考古研究会怎样收场……
say:3:1021102502:1.male: I can't even imagine the outcome of our research trip without you...
say:3:1021102502:1.female: I can't even imagine the outcome of our research trip without you...

say:4:1021102503:1.text: Thank you, my great mage friend! I shall dedicate a whole 6-inch section of my paper to acknowledge your contribution!
say:4:1021102503:1.source_cn: 感谢你，伟大的魔法师朋友！我会在论文里给你留出整整六英...
say:4:1021102503:1.male: Thank you, my great mage friend! I shall dedicate a whole 6-inch section of my paper to acknowledge your contribution!
say:4:1021102503:1.female: Thank you, my great mage friend! I shall dedicate a whole 6-inch section of my paper to acknowledge your contribution!

say:5:1021102504:1.text: So, can we start the research now?
say:5:1021102504:1.source_cn: 所以，我们可以开始研究了吗？
say:5:1021102504:1.male: So, can we start the research now?
say:5:1021102504:1.female: So, can we start the research now?

say:6:1021102505:1.text: Gali! Were I alone on this trip, I would not have encountered all this trouble!
say:6:1021102505:1.source_cn: ——伽利！！如果这场旅途只有我一个人，根本不会遇到这些...

say:7:1021102506:1.text: No time for complaints! To unveil the dusty pages of Esperia's history, we must get to work! Get your shovel and some papers now!
say:7:1021102506:1.source_cn: 现在不是抱怨的时候，为了不让伊索米亚的光辉历史蒙尘，我...

say:8:1021102507:1.text: *Sigh*... Magister, please take this as a token of our gratitude after all the trouble...
say:8:1021102507:1.male: *Sigh*... Magister, please take this as a token of our gratitude after all the trouble...
say:8:1021102507:1.female: *Sigh*... Magister, please take this as a token of our gratitude after all the trouble...

choice_prompt:9:1021102507.text: *Sigh*... Magister, please take this as a token of our gratitude after all the trouble...
choice_prompt:9:1021102507.source_cn: 唉，魔法师<male>先生</male><female>小姐</female>，请收下这件小小的礼物，作为我们麻烦你的谢礼……
choice_prompt:9:1021102507.male: *Sigh*... Magister, please take this as a token of our gratitude after all the trouble...
choice_prompt:9:1021102507.female: *Sigh*... Magister, please take this as a token of our gratitude after all the trouble...

say:10:1021102508:1.female: It's only just begun. Gali and I are researching the <style="highlight">fall of the gods</style> and how it happened. Unless we're lucky, we'll end up digging for the next decade without publishing a single paper...

say:11:1021102509:1.text: In the future, I won't let Gali touch anything in the ruins without my permission!
say:11:1021102509:1.source_cn: 当然，如果以后再见，我肯定会看住伽利的手！不能再让他乱...
say:11:1021102509:1.male: In the future, I won't let Gali touch anything in the ruins without my permission!
say:11:1021102509:1.female: In the future, I won't let Gali touch anything in the ruins without my permission!

say:13:1021102510:1.text: ... My official application for a new research partner was declined...
say:13:1021102510:1.source_cn: ……虽然我更换搭档的申请被驳回了……
say:13:1021102510:1.male: ... My official application for a new research partner was declined...
say:13:1021102510:1.female: ... My official application for a new research partner was declined...

say:14:1021102511:1.text: I keep persuading myself that Gali still has something to offer.
say:14:1021102511:1.source_cn: “伽利也不是全无优点！”我是这么说服自己的。
say:14:1021102511:1.male: I keep persuading myself that Gali still has something to offer.
say:14:1021102511:1.female: I keep persuading myself that Gali still has something to offer.

say:15:1021102512:1.text: After all, I can't do every task myself. An enthusiastic—probably too enthusiastic—research partner can keep me company at the dig site at night.
say:15:1021102512:1.source_cn: 毕竟考古工作只靠我一个人确实无法完成，能有一位热情高涨...
say:15:1021102512:1.male: After all, I can't do every task myself. An enthusiastic—probably too enthusiastic—research partner can keep me company at the dig site at night.
say:15:1021102512:1.female: After all, I can't do every task myself. An enthusiastic—probably too enthusiastic—research partner can keep me company at the dig site at night.

say:18:1021102515:1.text: Once again, you have my thanks, Magister.
say:18:1021102515:1.source_cn: 那么，再次向你致意，魔法师<male>先生</male...
say:18:1021102515:1.male: Once again, you have my thanks, Magister.
say:18:1021102515:1.female: Once again, you have my thanks, Magister.

say:19:1021102516:1.text: Maybe fate will allow us to meet again somewhere in the ruins of Esperia.
say:19:1021102516:1.source_cn: 要是有缘的话，以后在伊索米亚的某处遗迹再见吧！
say:19:1021102516:1.male: Maybe fate will allow us to meet again somewhere in the ruins of Esperia.
say:19:1021102516:1.female: Maybe fate will allow us to meet again somewhere in the ruins of Esperia.

choice:12:0:1.text: How do you put up with him?
choice:12:0:1.male: How do you put up with him?
choice:12:0:1.female: How do you put up with him?

say:0:1021102601:0.text: *Sigh*... I thought that was the end of my research.
say:0:1021102601:0.source_cn: 呼……我刚才以为研究就要在这里结束了。
say:0:1021102601:0.male: *Sigh*... I thought that was the end of my research.
say:0:1021102601:0.female: *Sigh*... I thought that was the end of my research.

say:1:1021102602:0.text: We're safe, thanks to you, Magister!
say:1:1021102602:0.source_cn: 多亏你保护了我们，魔法师朋友。
say:1:1021102602:0.male: We're safe, thanks to you, Magister!
say:1:1021102602:0.female: We're safe, thanks to you, Magister!

say:1:1021103202:0.source_cn: 不，这是误会，请听我们说！

say:2:1021103203:0.source_cn: 我们并不是入侵者，只是在寻找遗迹！

say:3:1021103204:0.text: Grug clah? Gu... grung? I forgot how to say "tablet"...
say:3:1021103204:0.source_cn: 咕、咕呜……？我想不起来“遗迹”这个词该怎么翻译了。

say:7:1021103208:0.text: "You... want... stone...?" Yes! We mean no harm!
say:7:1021103208:0.source_cn: “石碑——你们——在找”，没错没错！我们没有恶意！
